messages:
maria (AE): Quick sync for FinData POC — customer wants a 3-week eval: LLM assistant over finance PDFs, embeddings + rerank for search, and tool-calling to their balance API. They asked about model fit, latency SLOs, and security controls.

olivia (SE): Good. Need clarity on query types (single-hop vs multi-doc), sample prompts/evals, doc sizes, and expected qps. :mag_right:

maria (AE): They sent ~200 eval queries — mix of short Q/A and multi-paragraph reasoning. Extracted docs up to ~8k tokens. Peak demo qps ~6, steady 1 qps. Target: <250ms/token on interactive flows and end-to-end <1.5s for short queries.

jake (SWE): For 8k contexts we have two practical options: retrieval pipeline (chunking -> embeddings -> reranker -> 8k-context generator) or a 32k-context model to ingest larger documents. Tool-calling needs function-calling enabled; will stub balance API for POC. Also recommend prefix KV cache for repeated prefixes.

olivia (SE): Proposal: run two arms in parallel and compare:
- Arm A (Retrieval): chunk -> embeddings -> rerank -> generate with 8k model.
- Arm B (Long-context): 32k model when full-doc reasoning is required.
A/B on quality, latency, cost.

neil (Security): They prefer Dedicated or Private with VPC peering. Requirements: customer-managed KMS, audit logs, RBAC, and explicit retention policy. I'll draft the questionnaire responses and call out exact network/KMS requirements.

amy (Pricing): Note: retrieval arm reduces gen token spend but adds embedding & rerank compute. 32k arm has higher per-token cost but simpler infra. For 3-week POC we can offer trial credits + Dedicated hours cap. I'll build a conservative cost estimate.

maria (AE): Customer success criteria they want:
1) P@1 >= 80% on their 200-query eval vs baseline
2) avg end-to-end latency <1.5s for short queries
3) secure network configured (VPC/peering or Dedicated)
4) demoable tool-calling flow with safe stubs
Timeline: week0 onboarding & infra, week1 baseline runs & eval harness, week2 tuning & reranks, week3 demo + handoff.

olivia (SE): Action items:
- olivia: build eval harness, ingest docs, produce embedding index (due in 4 business days)
- jake: prototype function-calling integration + balance API stub (3 business days) — include request/response schema
- neil: draft security questionnaire answers + infra checklist (2 business days)
- amy: send POC cost cap and pricing note (EOD tomorrow)

jake (SWE): Retrieval-arm starter config for the POC (notes):
```
model: rwd-8k-gen-v1
embeddings: rwd-embed-2
reranker: light-ranker-v1
batching: adaptive (max_tokens=2048)
tool_calling: enabled -> balance_api_stub
cache: prefix-kv enabled
```
Estimate: ~120-180ms/token on Dedicated with 1 GPU pool; should meet short-query SLO for interactive flows.

olivia (SE): Long-context arm config notes:
```
model: rwd-32k-qa-v1
tool_calling: enabled
quantization: int8 (if quality acceptable)
latency_est: 200-400ms per token (higher cost)
```
We'll run both arms on their 200-query eval set and compare P@1, MRR@5, latency, and cost.

neil (Security): Infra checklist (high level): Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering + customer KMS, RBAC for service tokens, ephemeral creds, audit logs with configurable retention (they requested 90 days). Will add exact wording on training-data opt-out.

maria (AE): Legal wants confirmation that PII will not be used for model training and that audit logs can be retained for 90 days. @neil can we confirm?

neil (Security): Confirmed: hosted has data retention opt-out and training-data opt-out. Dedicated/Private customers control persistence. I'll add the precise clauses in the questionnaire draft.

amy (Pricing): Draft POC budget (3 weeks): Retrieval arm $2.5k - $4k; 32k arm $6k - $9k. Spreadsheet with assumptions will be shared.

olivia (SE): Testing notes — include stress test at 10 qps for 5 minutes to validate autoscaling and batching. Capture token distribution histograms and tail latencies (p95/p99).

jake (SWE): On tool-calling concurrency: demo uses stubbed endpoints. Production integration will require connection pooling and RBAC. Call out expected concurrency limits in the integration guide.

olivia (SE): Eval metrics to surface: P@1, MRR@5, avg tokens per response, p95 latency, and cost per successful answer. These map directly to customer success criteria.

maria (AE): Next steps: olivia to post eval harness link + initial baseline run by Friday; jake to push balance stub branch; neil to share questionnaire draft; amy to send pricing cap. I'll book demo slot for week 3. Thanks all :rocket: 

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/jake/balance-stub -> staging at 2024-06-12T14:05:23Z

olivia (SE): Got the deploy notice — will run baseline once staging is up.

maria (AE): Keeping this thread as the single source for quick Qs. Move artifacts into the shared POC folder when ready. @here if anything urgent.
